name: Vedant Fashions Ltd
about: Vedant Fashions Limited caters to the Indian celebration wear market with a diverse portfolio of brands. The company offers its customers a one-stop destination for every celebratory occasion and the largest men's Indian wedding and celebration wear by revenue.VFL commands a dominant position in conventionally unorganized market segment.[1]
